                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
                )
                if crossed_above:
                    target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * self.strategy_a_percent
                    quantity = int(target_value // spy_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
                red_three_days = (
                    self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
                    and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
                    and aapl_close < self.aapl_closes[1]
                )
                if red_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.spy_previous_close = spy_close
        self.spy_previous_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_close)

class PrivateLotStrategiesAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.spy_sma_values = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.strategy_a_portfolio_percent = 1.0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                continue

            bar = data.Bars[symbol]

            if symbol == self.spy:
                self.spy_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
                self.spy_closes.Add(float(bar.Close))
                if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                    self.spy_sma_values.Add(float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value))

            if symbol == self.aapl:
                self.aapl_rsi.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
                self.aapl_closes.Add(float(bar.Close))

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.IsReady or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady or
                self.spy_closes.Count < 2 or
                self.spy_sma_values.Count < 2 or
                self.aapl_closes.Count < 4):
            return

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

        spy_crosses_below = (
            self.spy_closes[1] >= self.spy_sma_values[1] and
            self.spy_closes[0] < self.spy_sma_values[0]
        )

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        spy_crosses_above = (
            self.spy_closes[1] <= self.spy_sma_values[1] and
            self.spy_closes[0] > self.spy_sma_values[0]
        )

        aapl_red_three_days = (
            self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1] and
            self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2] and
            self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
        )

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            quantity = int(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * self.strategy_a_portfolio_percent)
                // spy_close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and aapl_red_three_days:
            cash_amount = 20_000
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_amount:
                quantity = int(cash_amount // aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

            spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            sma_value = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            ready = (
                self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and prior_spy_close is not None
                and prior_spy_sma is not None
            )

            if ready:
                strategy_a_sell = (
                    prior_spy_close >= prior_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < sma_value
                )
                strategy_b_sell = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60

                if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and strategy_a_sell:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = 0

                if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and strategy_b_sell:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = 0

                strategy_a_buy = (
                    prior_spy_close <= prior_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > sma_value
                )

                if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and strategy_a_buy:
                    target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * self.strategy_a_percent
                    quantity = int(target_value // spy_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

                if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                    if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                        quantity = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.Close)
                        if quantity > 0:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                            self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
